photos.title: File:Sorghastrum nutans (3912213615).jpg
photos.author: Matt Lavin from Bozeman, Montana, USA
photos.description: The inflorescence comprises a panicle of spikelet pairs (sessile and pedicellate), but in Sorghastrum, the pedicellate spikelet is reduced to nothing, so each sessile spikelet is associated with a naked pedicel. The terminal sessile spikelet shown here is associated with two naked pecicels (a pedicellate spikelet terminates inflorescence branches in tribe Andropogoneae).
